what: Plan omits suppression of helper stdout on child commands
scenario_or_breakage: The current shell suppresses helper stdout, but launch-claude-review emits STATUS/OUTPUT_FILE/ELAPSED KVs and run-log append-failure emits APPENDED/LOG; inherited stdout would pollute agent dispatch-voters stdout and break byte-compatible downstream KV parsing
suggested_fix: Capture or redirect helper stdout for all child commands except outputs intentionally parsed, especially set stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL for the Claude Popen and do not re-emit append-failure output

what: Plan omits the voter wait timeout contract
scenario_or_breakage: The retired dispatcher passes --timeout ${LARCH_VOTER_WAIT_TIMEOUT:-60}, but agent wait-reviewers defaults to 1860 seconds; omitting this makes missing sentinels wait about 31 minutes instead of the voter-dispatch 60-second default and ignores the test/runtime override
suggested_fix: Pass --timeout from LARCH_VOTER_WAIT_TIMEOUT with default 60 when invoking agent wait-reviewers, and keep the existing timeout override covered in the wait-barrier tests
